Energy · Europe

Only 16 of Europe's 41 countries generate nuclear electricity — and three of them carry most of it

Of the 41 European countries reporting electricity generation in 2024, only 16 produced any nuclear power at all.

Even among those 16, output is concentrated: France, Russia and Spain alone account for 69 % of Europe's nuclear generation.

France leads by far — 380 TWh in 2024, nearly twice Russia's 216 TWh, the next largest producer.
